1.

Thanks, Lord Jesus Christ, That all our sin and lack Hast Thou, God’s Lamb, Removed on that day, When in our stead Thou stoodst And didst let Thy blood flow Upon the cross’s stem!

2.

Thou wast the offering Lamb For Jews, Gentiles Upon this earth. That offering shall avail Before God in eternity For the salvation Of those who believe God’s word.

3.

In heaven itself For us Thou dost appear Before Thy God; And in His sanctuary In assurance of faith we may Proceed in worship In holy attire.
